name: relay-proof
description: Describe what should work, run it, and get a verdict through a local Relay service.

interface.longDescription: Describe what should work in a sentence: Relay writes and saves the Test, runs it on a browser or device, and returns one verdict with the failing step's expected vs. saw. After a code change, check the app's Tests. Record a step only when it must be exact or model-free. Change Proof remains an explicit specialist workflow.
defaultPrompt: Describe what should work in this app and run it.
Check my change against this app's tests.
Explain why my last run failed.
